sentences.text:
Khokan Mandal & Ors vs Unknown on 20 March, 2023
Author: Debangsu Basak

Bench: Debangsu Basak
 C.R.M. (A) 890 of 2023
20.03.2023
In Re: - An application for anticipatory bail under Section 438 of Sl.2 the Code of Criminal
Procedure in connection with G.R. No.5952 Court No.29 of 2021 arising out of Habibpur Police
Station Case No.335 of (Ad) 2021 dated 25.10.2021 under Sections 498A/304(B)/34 of the Indian
Penal Code, 1860..
And In the matter of: Khokan Mandal & Ors.
....petitioners.
Ms. Jeenia Rudra ... for the petitioners.

Ms. Faria Hossain Ms. Mamata Jana ...for the State.
The Court is informed that the Special Leave Petition is still pending.
In such circumstances, list the application in the monthly list of May, 2023.
Interim protection granted on March 2, 2023 will continue until further orders.

(Debangsu Basak, J.) (Md. Shabbar Rashidi, J.)
